newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changan Jan-Oct sales hit 1.96 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Changan Jan-Oct sales hit 1.96 bln yuan.

text.p: Sichuan-based Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd racked up 1.96 billion yuan in sales in the first 10 months of this year and is likely to exceed its 1996 net profit target, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
Changan had sales of 860 million yuan in the July to October period of this year, with 26,000 mini cars sold, the newspaper quoted a Changan spokesman as saying.
The spokesman said Changan expects to sell 16,000 cars in the last two months of the year.

In a B share offer prospectus, Changan said that under international accounting standards, it has forecast net earnings of a minimum of 220 million yuan for this year, compared with 220.16 million yuan last year and 192.52 million yuan in 1994.
Changan said it had after-tax profits of 82.63 million yuan in the first half of this year. It did not give a comparative figure.

The company said it had sales of 2.40 billion yuan last year, compared with 2.50 billion yuan in 1994 and 2.11 billion yuan a year earlier. It had sales of 1.08 billion yuan in the first half of 1996.
Company officials were not available for further details. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
